top_comments.text: Adding a Chrome extension and giving it access like that?! Korean hacker group is a huge risk. Along with that there is reportedly 1000's in the Chrome store. Several the same ones Microsoft reports as malware, the their removal from the store. This is where malware injects itself. The same, little plugs, extension, app that brings convince and passes all spurt checks. Add to that it is tied to AI and you are rolling the dice! Everybody just installed apps, plugins, whatever AI wants to because it's convenient. Hackers don't at immediately. This gibes them access and they sit and wait. Either to steal your info t use or sell at a later date OR maybe use you as a bot for state spends attacks. Don't be a statistic and install extensions just because it's cool and new.
